raw_response:
I have 10.1 mu, same as last year. I plant wheat after autumn harvest and maize after wheat harvest. I never went to school, but I have farmed 15 years and I know what works. I watch what my neighbors do.

For wheat: I rotary till the field first. I buy wheat seed from the shop, 30 jin per mu. For fertilizer, I put one bag of compound fertilizer per mu as base — that is 100 jin per mu, the one they sell at the cooperative, 18-22-5. Then in March when the wheat wakes up, I spread one bag of ammonium bicarbonate per mu, 100 jin. Last year I did this and got about 1000 jin per mu. I am not changing it. I irrigate three times: winter water, jointing water, and grain-filling water. I have a well so I use my pump. For spraying, I do herbicide once after sowing, insecticide twice in spring, and one fungicide when it gets warm. That is four times total. Better to spray than to lose half the field to bugs.

For maize: After I cut the wheat, I plant maize straight away, no tillage. I buy hybrid seed, 1.2 bags per mu, about 60 yuan each bag. At planting I put one bag of high-nitrogen compound per mu — 27-6-7, 100 jin per mu. When the corn grows to the trumpet stage, I topdress with 20 jin of urea per mu. My cousin did this last year and his corn was better than mine. I irrigate twice. For medicine, I spray insecticide three times, herbicide once, and I use that regulator once so the stalks don't fall over. That is five times. I expect about 1200 jin per mu.

My family has six people. My wife and I do the farming, my younger brother works in the factory in Handan and sends money home. My parents help when we are busy but they are getting old. I have to think about money — fertilizer is expensive, but if the harvest fails, we have nothing. So I would rather put a bit more than risk it.
